description: Cavallo, a little gem of the Lavezzi archipelago, has always sparked envy. Once the scene of wild parties, it drew the international jet set before becoming a target for nationalists and organized crime groups. In June, the local government launched an offensive to regain control of the port and open the island up to tourists.

description: Le Monde's pick for cultural highlights in France include a pop art tour on the island of Porquerolles, an immersive dive into Vietnamese cultures in Paris and an exhibition in Toulon exploring textile innovations in design.

headline: The letters from two Ukrainian sisters: 'Stay in bed or take shelter elsewhere: a life-or-death decision'
description: Sasha and Olga Kurovska are two Ukrainian sisters, one lives in Kyiv, the other in Paris. Faced with Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure, Sasha admires her fellow citizens' determination to never give up, while Olga, fresh from a month-long stay in Ukraine, better understands her sister's reactions to the constant threat of bombing.

description: From the CFDT trade union to presidential candidates Raphaël Glucksmann and Marine Tondelier, the idea of increasing inheritance taxes is back on the table. The far-right Rassemblement National opposes it. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is considering another option: compulsory philanthropy for large inheritances.
